name: CountdownTimer
src_typeComment: Plain timer driven manually via Tick(deltaTime) — works the same for a UI cooldown display, an ability cooldown, or a simple "wait N seconds" without spawning a coroutine.

src_members.sig: public float Duration { get; private set; }
src_members.name: Duration

src_members.sig: public float TimeRemaining { get; private set; }
src_members.name: TimeRemaining

src_members.sig: public bool IsRunning { get; private set; }
src_members.name: IsRunning
Progress
src_members.comment: 0 = just started, 1 = finished. Feed this straight into a UI fill-bar Image.

src_members.name: Stop
src_members.comment: Pauses without resetting TimeRemaining — use Resume() to continue, or Start() to restart from Duration.

src_members.name: Resume
src_members.comment: Continues from wherever TimeRemaining was left off after Stop(). No-op if there's no time left.

src_members.name: Tick
src_members.comment: Call this once per frame (e.g. from Update) with Time.deltaTime.
